100551.title: Handlebar component fit overview
guidance: Inspect 1.00 EA of Handlebar Tube (Product Number HT-2981) for visible damage and support it in an assumed padded assembly jig.
Inspect 1.00 EA of Stem (Product Number SM-9087) and position it near the center of the bar for a conceptual fit check. Attachment details are unspecified; see illustration 100551.
Apply 40.00 IN of HL Grip Tape (Product Number GT-2908) across the two grip areas, using the assumed equal division. Check for loose edges.
Fit 2.00 EA of Mountain End Caps (Product Number EC-M092), one at each bar end, and visually check their seating. Hold the demonstration assembly for review of the unspecified stem connection.
